item.command:
/opt/homebrew/bin/bash -lc '"$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/001 --status met --source judgement --reason '"'All study inputs, code, environment, results and run logs are under one root; the skills dependency is a pinned submodule.' --evidence 'README.md=describes the repository product and layout' --evidence '.gitmodules=skills submodule is bounded under root'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/002 --status met --source probe:subdatasets-resolvable --reason '"'The skills submodule URL resolves; study maps are under input/data as annex content.' --evidence '.gitmodules=skills URL resolved by remote probe' --evidence 'input/sources.json=map source and participant manifest'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/003 --status met --source judgement --reason '"'Scientific packages, git-annex and duct are in the Pixi environment; README documents Git and Pixi setup.' --evidence 'pixi.toml=runtime and analysis dependencies' --evidence 'README.md=installation prerequisites'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/004 --status met --source probe:tree-clean --reason '"'Git tracks code, text and configuration; the worker-stop receipt records this exact commit with a clean tree.' --evidence 'git status --porcelain=empty at target commit 8b5bcdaa' --evidence '/Users/johnlee/.local/state/stamped-ai-research-next/preparation-20261015/cold-stamped-op-evidence/judgment-01/worker-end-state.json=clean worker stop at requested HEAD'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/005 --status met --source probe:large-in-annex --reason '"'Git-annex tracks the 54 participant maps and other large content; no oversized binary blobs are in Git.' --evidence 'input/data=60 annex pointers per large-in-annex probe' --evidence '.datalad/config=git-annex configuration'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/006 --status met --source probe:derived-have-records+judgement --flag probe-overridden --reason '"'The final run record hashes code, Pixi manifest/lock, inputs and 14 outputs; the path probe missed this linked record.' --evidence 'logs/20261015T233701Z-provenance.json=run id, code revision, lock hashes and output hashes' --evidence 'scripts/write_run_record.py=creates the linked provenance manifest'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/007 --status met --source probe:entry-point --reason '"'README gives locked Pixi installation, annex retrieval and run instructions.' --evidence 'README.md=Prerequisites and setup; Run and validate'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/008 --status met --source probe:entry-point --reason '"'The README identifies pixi run recorded-analysis and the tracked run wrapper as the starting point.' --evidence 'README.md=Run and validate' --evidence 'scripts/run_recorded_analysis.sh=documented entrypoint'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/009 --status met --source probe:no-abs-paths --reason '"'The probe found no host-specific absolute paths in tracked text.' --evidence 'probe:no-abs-paths=177 tracked paths scanned, zero hits'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/010 --status met --source probe:env-spec-tracked+judgement --flag probe-overridden --reason '"'Imports and invoked tools are declared in Pixi, including neuroimaging packages, Git-annex and duct; no missing runtime dependency was found.' --evidence 'pixi.toml=declared dependencies and tasks' --evidence 'scripts/analyze.py=imports and invoked code' --evidence 'scripts/run_recorded_analysis.sh=execution route'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/011 --status met --source judgement --reason '"'README states macOS 14+ ARM64 and Linux x86-64; the documented route names Git, Pixi and annex retrieval.' --evidence 'README.md=Prerequisites and setup'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/012 --status met --source judgement --reason '"'README lists Git, Pixi, supported platforms and the locked environment installation.' --evidence 'README.md=Prerequisites and setup' --evidence 'pixi.toml=platform and dependency declarations'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/013 --status met --source probe:env-spec-tracked+judgement --flag probe-overridden --reason '"'pixi.toml and pixi.lock are tracked at the assessed commit; an uninitialized skills submodule does not hold the analysis environment.' --evidence 'pixi.toml=tracked environment declaration' --evidence 'pixi.lock=tracked lock'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/014 --status met --source judgement --flag upstream-duplicate --reason '"'README gives pixi add/remove and requires reviewing and committing manifest plus lock; history shows dependency changes and tracked lock updates.' --evidence 'README.md=Update the environment' --evidence 'git log -- pixi.toml pixi.lock=dependency/environment changes tracked'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/015 --status met --source judgement --reason '"'The object carries the committed Pixi lock and run-specific manifest/lock hashes, enabling an exact environment attempt.' --evidence 'pixi.lock=tracked frozen package resolution' --evidence 'logs/20261015T233701Z-provenance.json=run-specific environment hashes'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/016 --status partial --source probe:env-spec-tracked+judgement --flag probe-overridden --reason '"'A clone of the hub parent repo lacks this commit; a local clone finds code/results but cannot retrieve 54 required maps from the declared annex remote.' --evidence '.git/config remote.con-hub=declared hub and annex URL; remote refs omit target commit' --evidence '2026-10-16-fresh-rerun.json=54 annex get errors, 16 result artifacts available' --evidence 'README.md=annex retrieval route'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/017 --status met --source judgement --reason '"'README explains Pixi installation, locked environment restoration, input retrieval and both analysis and validation commands.' --evidence 'README.md=Prerequisites and setup; Run and validate'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item should/001 --status met --source judgement --reason '"'Git tracks project text, code and environment; git-annex handles large files and the skills module is a Git submodule.' --evidence '.gitmodules=skills Git submodule' --evidence 'input/data=git-annex content'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item should/002 --status unmet --source probe:ci-present --reason '"'No CI workflow or recurring test route was found to check that README instructions remain accurate.' --evidence 'probe:ci-present=configs empty' --evidence 'README.md=manual run instructions only'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item should/003 --status met --source probe:modules-separated --reason '"'Inputs, analysis code, results and environment files occupy distinct named project areas.' --evidence 'input/, scripts/, results/, pixi.toml, pixi.lock=separated components'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item should/004 --status unmet --source judgement --reason '"'No clean VM, container or cloud run is recorded; the authorized fresh clone stopped when 54 maps could not be retrieved.' --evidence '2026-10-16-fresh-rerun.json=local clone replay blocked at annex retrieval' --evidence 'logs/replay-compare-final-20261015-stdout=earlier same-host replay, not isolated host'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item should/005 --status unmet --source judgement --reason '"'The README runs analyses in a persistent Pixi project environment; no disposable environment is spawned for each run.' --evidence 'README.md=pixi install then pixi run' --evidence 'pixi.toml=local task definitions'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item should/006 --status partial --source probe:ci-present+judgement --flag probe-overridden --reason '"'One same-host replay tested the lock once, but no recurring exact-environment CI or periodic reconstitution test is recorded.' --evidence 'logs/replay-compare-final-20261015-stdout=one byte-identical replay of 15 artifacts' --evidence 'probe:ci-present=no CI configurations found'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item should/007 --status unmet --source judgement --reason '"'The lock and manifest are archived, but executable environment artifacts or binaries are not stored with the object.' --evidence 'pixi.toml; pixi.lock=specifications only'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item should/008 --status met --source judgement --flag upstream-duplicate --reason '"'Same documented update procedure and history as must/014: Pixi changes are reviewed and committed with the lock.' --evidence 'README.md=Update the environment' --evidence 'git log -- pixi.toml pixi.lock=tracked dependency updates'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item should/009 --status not-applicable --source judgement --reason '"'N/A: all supplied maps and software components are public; there is no restricted component to isolate.' --evidence 'input/sources.json=public NeuroVault sources'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item may/001 --status met --source probe:subdatasets-resolvable --reason '"'The pinned skills dependency is a resolvable Git submodule; participant maps are separately linked by git-annex.' --evidence '.gitmodules=skills URL and commit' --evidence 'input/data=annex pointers'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item may/002 --status met --source judgement --reason '"'README describes the inputs, code, results and environment areas and how to run the analysis.' --evidence 'README.md=layout and reproduction instructions'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item may/003 --status met --source judgement --reason '"'Code, source inputs, result outputs and environment specs can be updated independently in their named areas.' --evidence 'input/, scripts/, results/, pixi.toml, pixi.lock=separate paths'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item may/004 --status met --source judgement --reason '"'README composes annex retrieval, locked Pixi setup and the recorded-analysis task into a reproducible sequence.' --evidence 'README.md=setup and run sequence' --evidence 'pixi.toml=recorded-analysis task'
\""'$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item may/005 --status met --source judgement --reason '"'README names component locations and the commands for restoring inputs, running analysis and validating results.' --evidence 'README.md=repository navigation and commands'
"
